articleTitle: Trends and prospects for radio over fibre picocells
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Radio over fibre is being used increasingly for the distribution of cellular communications signals to extend both coverage and capacity within buildings and also in metropolitan areas. This paper explores the trends and prospects for this important application.

articleTitle: Photonic techniques for local oscillator generation and distribution in millimeter-wave radio astronomy
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A number of photonics techniques are being used for Local Oscillator (LO) generation and distribution for millimeter-wavelength radio astronomy. Many of these are being implemented or considered for use on the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) project.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of 800-nm band optical wireless link for new generation mobile radio access network
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The atmospheric propagation properties of an 800 nm band optical wireless link are evaluated experimentally. The applicability of an optical wireless link to a radio access network is considered, based on experimental results from the viewpoint of link availability.

articleTitle: Direct modulated lasers in radio over fiber applications
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A theoretical and experimental study of using direct modulated optical transmitters in radio over fiber applications is presented. State-of-the-art Fabry-Perot, DFB and VCSEL lasers are evaluated and compared in short-range multi-carrier transmission by detailed nonlinear characterization.

articleTitle: Millimetre wave generation using an optical comb generator with optical phase-locked loops
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We report the generation of millimetre wave signals to 158 GHz with phase noise better than 75 dBC/Hz at 100 kHz offset, by heterodyning of two lasers which are optically phase locked through an optical comb generator.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic THz transmitter employing ultra-broadband travelling-wave 1.55 /spl mu/m photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We report on antenna and waveguide coupled photonic THz transmitter employing ultrabroadband 1.55 /spl mu/m travelling-wave photodetectors. Optical heterodyne submm-wave generation is experimentally investigated up to 1 THz.

articleTitle: All-optical radio-independent millimeter-wave radio-on-fiber system with lean antenna base stations
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We propose and investigate a novel radio-independent (20-60 GHz) radio-on-fiber system with an all-optical analogue radio head-end in the central station and lean single-optical component antenna base stations employing millimeter-wave electroabsorption transceivers (EAT).

articleTitle: Generation and transmission of tunable terahertz optical clock
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A method of generating an optical clock that can be tuned from 100 GHz to 1 THz and the transmission of the optical clock thorough a 20 km-long single-mode fiber are demonstrated. The generation method employs three techniques: the modulation of CW light by an electroabsorption modulator, pulse spectrum expansion through higher-order soliton compression, and spectrum filtering by using two fiber Bragg grating filters with tuning range of over 1 THz.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of AM-AM/PM nonlinear distortion due to direct laser modulation in radio over fibre systems
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of nonlinear distortion in radio-over-fibre (RoF) systems based on an AM-AM/PM behavioural model. Simulation results show similar characteristics to measured results that have been reported. The error vector magnitude (EVM) and spectral regrowth (ACPR) are theoretically analysed and their correlationships are verified by simulation. Uncoded BER degradations are also presented.

articleTitle: Flexible and tunable microwave filters based on arrayed waveguide gratings
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated a new optical signal processor based on the use of Arrayed Waveguide Gratings (AWG). The structure exploits the concept of spectra slicing combined with the use of dispersive optical components.

articleTitle: Capacity analysis and optimum channel allocations for a WDM ring fiber-radio backbone incorporating wavelength interleaving with a sectorized antenna interface
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We investigate the capacity limitations of a WDM ring fiber-radio backbone, incorporating wavelength interleaving, where each base station drives a sectorized antenna interface. We also investigate the optimum allocations for the interleaved channels to efficiently drive the sectorized antenna interface that overcomes one of the capacity limitations for such a network.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated optoelectronic circuits using HBT, EAM, and TEAT
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Monolithically integrated optoelectronic circuits using HBTs, EAMs and novel multifunctional transistor electroabsorption transceivers (TEATs) are demonstrated. In particular, we present an EAM monolithically integrated with a driver circuit and a novel optoelectronic differential amplifier.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 622 Mbps millimeter-wave over fiber link for broadband fixed wireless access system
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We demonstrated the analogue transmission of a 622 Mbps millimeter-wave signal over optical fiber for a broadband fixed wireless access system. The transferred RF signal format was based on four multi-carriers in a 37 GHz band with a 64 QAM modulation. The experiments showed that we can successfully transfer a 622 Mbps millimeter-wave signal over a 10 km fiber with less than 5 dB power penalty for a downlink and less than 4 dB CNR penalty for an uplink.

articleTitle: Adaptive RF-photonic arbitrary waveform generator
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The system uses spectral shaping of a supercontinuum source followed by wavelength-to-time mapping to generate ultra wideband RF waveforms with arbitrary modulation. It employs adaptive computer control to mitigate the non-ideal features inherent in the optical source and in the spectrum modulation process. As proof of concept, ultra-wideband frequency hopped CDMA waveforms are demonstrated.

articleTitle: The optical remote antenna for the digital TV broadcasting relay networking
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A new concept optical transmission system with LiNbO/sub 3/ crystal has been developed. The sensitivity and the bandwidth are improved with this system for the new digital TV broadcasting relay networking in Japan compared with the conventional optical modulator.

articleTitle: Optimization of InP/GaInAs heterojunction bipolar transistors and phototransistors
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The tradeoffs encountered in monolithic integration of p-i-n photodetectors and heterojunction bipolar transistors are described. For further improving the frequency performance of the individual transistors, the main challenges related to epitaxy are shortening of the base transit time by band gap engineering, and the proper grading of the base emitter and base collector junctions.

articleTitle: Fabrication of broad-band fiber-optic magnetic field probe and its application to intensity and phase distribution measurements of GHz-frequency magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Magneto-optic probes with bandwidths of 10 GHz or broader were implemented using rotation magnetization in BiRIG crystals. Two-dimensional RF magnetic field distributions were measured successfully over the GHz-band on microstrip line circuits.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of detuned loading effects on distortion in edge emitting DBR lasers
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Detuned loading in directly modulated DBR lasers has been evaluated. IMD3 was measured, yielding a spurious free dynamic range of >103 dB/Hz/sup 2/3/ for frequencies 1-19 GHz with a top value of 116 dB/Hz/sup 2/3/ at 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Radio-on-fiber link using direct modulation in 5-GHz band
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We have developed a 5-GHz radio-on-fiber link using a narrow-band DFB-LD and temperature control-free technique. Performance of IM3 /spl les/ -40 dBc and CNR /spl ges/ 50 dB was achieved between -10 and 60 degrees, and 16-optical-distribution in 2-km transmission was also estimated.

articleTitle: Optical arbitrary waveform generator for radar applications at high frequency resolution
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: In future radar systems, highly complex synthetic waveforms are needed to perform sophisticated signal processing functions at high speed. An opto-electronic arbitrary radar waveform generator is proposed. It permits one to generate predefined waveforms by driving phase-amplitude distributions of optically carried microwave signals.

articleTitle: Compact 60-GHz photonic millimeter-wave emitter module for fiber radio link
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We developed a compact photonic emitter module for a 60 GHz fiber radio downlink with an estimated equivalent isotropically radiated power of 18 dBm. Phase-shift keyed data transmission is experimentally demonstrated at 2.5 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Millimetre-wave InP/InGaAs photo-HBT and its application to a double-stage cascode optoelectronic mixer
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present an ultra-high-speed InP/InGaAs bipolar phototransistor (HPT) with a record optical gain cut-off frequency of 110 GHz and an HPT/HBT two-stage cascode upconverting mixer with a conversion gain of 17 dB at 28 GHz, that is also the highest reported for monolithically integrated optoelectronic mixers.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic source for coherent Doppler LIDAR system operating at 1550 nm
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present theoretical and experimental results for a microwave photonic oscillator (MPO) that provides a microwave signal and a modulated optical wave simultaneously, and which can be used as a local oscillator for a coherent Doppler LIDAR operating at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave photonic wireless link using low-cost generation and modulation techniques
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present low-cost 120-GHz millimeter-wave (MMW) photonic wireless links that employ optical MMW generation using a Fabry-Perot laser and MMW modulation by controlling photodiode bias voltage. The link achieved 1.25-Gbit/s wireless data transmission.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects in optical-wireless OFDM signal transmission
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper is concerned with the analysis of nonlinear effects in fiber-radio systems and wireless local area networks. Using the OFDM technique, the crucial parameters of the transmission are the nonlinearities and the phase-noise of microwave and optical oscillators. A summary of the distorting effects and possible solutions are also presented.

articleTitle: Transmission power reduction effect in wireless CDMA system employing ROF ubiquitous antenna architecture
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper theoretically analyzes the reduction effect of transmitting power and its controlling range in a wireless CDMA system employing an ROF ubiquitous antenna architecture. Theoretical BER analysis shows that the highest required transmitting power is reduced by about 11 dB.

articleTitle: Microstrip phased array patch antenna based on a liquid crystal phase shifter for optically generated RF-signals
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We report on a 1/spl times/2 phased array antenna with an optical beamforming network and liquid crystal phase shifter, which allows a continuous microwave phase deviation up to 90/spl deg/. Experiments in steering the antenna pattern are discussed.

articleTitle: Binary and ternary architectures for a two-channel 5-bit optical receive beamformer
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A binary and ternary 5 bit programmable dispersion matrix is built to control a two-channel receiver beamformer at 1550 nm. Phase measurements for the delay configurations along with beam-patterns at RF frequencies of 0.2-1 GHz are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave photo-diode module integrated with a preamplifier IC using a flip-chip bonding technique
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We propose a photo-diode module integrated with a pre-amplifier IC using a novel flip-chip bonding technique. An Au stud bump is used as a bonding material, and the waveguide photodiode is directly mounted on an InP hetero bipolar transistor IC.

articleTitle: A novel channel section scheme with optical heterodyne detection using dual-mode local light for DWDM millimeter-wave-band radio-on-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A novel channel selection scheme of DWDM 60-GHz-band radio-on-fiber signals by optical heterodyne detection with a dual-mode local light is proposed. Error-free demultiplexing and transmission over 25-km-long SMF of the DWDM signal are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Gain saturated SOA cascaded EML analog optical transmitter
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present an improvement in an analog optical transmission performance by reducing both the nonlinearity and the periodic RF carrier suppression. The proposed technique takes advantage of the gain saturation characteristics of a semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) to reduce the intrinsic nonlinearity of an electroabsorption-modulated laser (EML) and the negative chirp characteristics of the SOA and EML to expand the transmission length and operating frequency. Furthermore, RF signal gain was also obtained through optical signal amplification.

articleTitle: CWDM microwave optical links for fiber-optic sectorized remote antenna system
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper introduces the coarse wavelength division multiplexing (CWDM) technique into microwave optical transmission systems. The key parameters of CWDM filters are described, and the design of the carrier-to-noise ratio and the 3rd order intermodulation distortion in the whole system, including the CWDM filters, is examined.

articleTitle: 25-GHz channel spacing DWDM demultiplexing for 60-GHz band radio-on-fiber systems using an arrayed waveguide grating
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate demultiplexing using an arrayed-waveguide grating for a DWDM mm-wave radio-on-fiber system by optical frequency interleaving. No noticeable power penalty was observed after 25 km SMF transmission when the channel spacing was 25 GHz.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multi-purpose fiber-optic access network (MFAN)
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Proposed and demonstrated a multipurpose fiber-optic access network (MFAN) which can be used to support various wired and wireless services using the same fiber infrastructure, including digital baseband, analog CATV, CDMA PCS, WLL, and LMCS services. The proposed network was implemented by using only three wavelengths separated by more than 20 nm. Thus, there was no need to use any complicated wavelength-stabilization circuitry. The crosstalk caused by either fiber nonlinearities or imperfect demultiplexers was measured to be negligible. The results confirm that MFAN could satisfy all the service requirements without significant crosstalk.

articleTitle: Normal-incidence 1.56-/spl mu/m MQW asymmetric Fabry-Perot modulator (AFPM) for passive picocells
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We have fabricated air-bridged modulators with bandwidths exceeding 10-GHz, the highest yet reported for InGaAsP/InGaAsP MQW AFPMs. Third-order intermodulation between the photodetected downlink signal and the modulated uplink signal is characterised for the first time.

articleTitle: Electro-optic field-mapping as a diagnostic tool for microwave circuits and antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The effectiveness of an optical-fiber-mounted electro-optic probe as a scanning electric-field-mapping tool is demonstrated in diagnostic measurements on microwave and millimeter-wave circuits, antennas, and arrays. A combined electric-field and thermal-imaging capability is also discussed.

articleTitle: Semiconductor optical amplifier chirp model for dispersive and nonlinear transmissions through single-mode fibers in microwave optical links
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A theoretical model to characterize the effect of the negative chirp introduced by a semiconductor optical amplifier booster, prior to a dispersive and nonlinear standard single-mode fiber transmission, is obtained. The theoretical expression gives the frequency transfer function of such a microwave optical link, showing a very good agreement with the experimental results.

articleTitle: The applications of SCM in optical data communications
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper outlines the progress made on the use of SCM for high speed data communications over multimode fibre. Results to be presented include transmission of 10 Gb/s, well beyond the fibre bandwidth, as well as 200 Gb/s transmission using a combination of SCM and WDM.

articleTitle: Optical modulation characteristics of 5.8 GHz OFDM signal with electro-absorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The optical modulation characteristics of a 5.8 GHz-band OFDM signal modulated by an EA modulator have been experimentally evaluated. No CNR degradation of the OFDM signal was observed when the RF power and bias voltage were optimized.

articleTitle: Implementation of microwave photonic filtering using a profiled superstructured fiber Bragg grating and dispersive fiber
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The microwave photonic response of a superstructured fiber Bragg grating is investigated. A bandpass response is achieved with the optical taps controlled by the combination of superstructured fiber grating characteristics and fiber dispersion. A rejection level of >45 dB is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A novel all-fiber bipolar transversal filter with complementary outputs
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A novel all-fiber bipolar delay line filter is realized in a single-line cascaded high birefringence fiber structure. Optically coherent operation is achieved with suppression of interference noise. Complementary filter outputs give simultaneous lowpass and highpass responses.

articleTitle: Low drive voltage and broad-band LiNbO/sub 3/ modulator
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The recent progress in the development of external LiNbO/sub 3/ modulators is summarized here. Especially, we focus on an approach to reduce drive voltage and enhance frequency performance.

articleTitle: Towards multi-channel time-domain terahertz imaging with photoconductive antennas
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We have constructed a small and cheap, yet efficient electronic circuit for reading out THz signals from photoconductive antennas. An 8-channel version of this circuit has been used for THz imaging by simultaneously recording sets of 8 time-domain THz waveforms with an array of 8 photoconductive antennas.

articleTitle: Modelling photonic bandgap structures in the microwave region near 10 GHz
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We designed and characterized photonic bandgap (PBG) structures in the microwave range. A PBG slab waveguide was defined by inserting line defects into a PBG sheet. Low-loss coupling to dielectric strip waveguides and external coaxial connectors could be achieved.

articleTitle: THz signal generation from a traveling-wave high-temperature superconductive photomixer
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of a traveling-wave HTS photomixer based on the kinetic inductive photoresponse principle. Discussion and simulation have been carried out to obtain the performance of the device for THz photonic applications.

articleTitle: Direct optical injection locking of a 96-GHz MMIC oscillator using a back-illuminated InP/InGaAs HPT
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A 96 GHz MMIC oscillator, using an InP/InGaAs HPT illuminated from the back side of the substrate, which can be injection locked by an optical signal of the 2nd-harmonic as well as the fundamental frequencies, is presented.

articleTitle: Experimental study of received signal performance in direct optical switching CDMA ROF system
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate interference suppression with an optical polarity-reversing correlator (OPRC) in the DOS-CDMA (direct optical switching CDMA) ROF (radio-over-fibre) system, and investigate carrier to interference power ratio (CIR) performance.

articleTitle: Wavelength self-tunable single-side-band InP:Fe filter model
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A model for the spectral response of wavelength-self-tunable single-side-band (WST-SSB) InP.Fe filters is proposed. In addition, good agreement of simulated SSB output spectrum with experimental data from a device set at 16 GHz validates the model.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional electric-field scanner using photonic techniques
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A novel electric-field scanner (E-Scan) allows us to obtain two-dimensional electric-field images in a short time by scanning with a laser beam. Measurement time with E-Scan is decreased by more than one order compared to previous electric-field mapping systems. We have demonstrated measurement of antenna radiation patterns and millimeter-wave imaging with E-Scan.

articleTitle: Tunable optical delay-line using an optical frequency shifter with a single-sideband modulator
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We propose a tunable delay-line using an optical frequency shifter, and an optical loop. The optical frequency shifter consists of an optical single sideband modulator. The number of times light circulates in the loop can be controlled by the electric signal fed to the modulator. Packets of any lengths can go through our proposed delay-line without any collisions, even if the length of the packet is larger than that of the delay loop.

articleTitle: Optical heterodyning receiver using optical single sideband injection locking of a DFB laser for a local oscillator booster
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a novel heterodyning method with injection of a pump and Stoke waves into a DFB laser. We observe optical mixing in the laser cavity. Preliminary experiments confirm the functionality in RF down-conversion.

articleTitle: Optical delay line using arrayed waveguide grating in fold-back configuration for phased-array antennas
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: An optical delay line (ODL) employing an arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) in a fold-back configuration is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. it offers crosstalk reduction, loss-imbalance and complementary delays as compared with a previously reported loop-back AWG-based ODL.

articleTitle: Nonlinear distortions and excess noise behavior of fused InGaAs/Si avalanche photodiode
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present measurements results of the two-tone intermodulation distortions in a fused InGaAs/Si avalanche photodiode that has potentially high gain and low excess noise performance.

articleTitle: Generation and detection of terahertz pulsed radiation with photoconductive antennas and their application to imaging
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: In this paper the authors describe photoconductive (PC) antennas, with a special focus on bandwidth properties of PC antennas as THz radiation sources and detectors. They also describe applications of the pulsed THz radiation to imaging based on PC antennas.

articleTitle: Towards terahertz photonics
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Optical generation of THz signals provides an attractive alternative to traditional methods. Recent progress in the generation and detection of mm-wave to THz modulated optical signals is described, including the important consideration of spectral purity.

articleTitle: 4 /spl times/ 2.5 GHz repetitive photonic sampler for high-speed analog to digital signal conversion
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A complete 10 Gsample/s photonic ADC system using a 4-wavelength picosecond pulse source is presented. Signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SINAD) is measured to be 40 dB and corresponds to 6 effective number of bits.

articleTitle: Highly birefringent photonic bandgap fibers and its dispersion properties
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A highly birefringent air-guiding photonic bandgap fiber is proposed and its dispersion properties are investigated. It is shown that the fiber has birefringence of the order of 10/sup -3/ and a large amount of group velocity dispersion.

articleTitle: Excitation of plasma oscillations and terahertz photomixing in high-electron mobility transistor
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We consider the excitation of plasma oscillations in the channel of a high-electron mobility transistor by transient near infrared radiation. This effect results in the pertinent excitation of the electric current in the external circuit that can be used for generation of terahertz electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Lightwave switching in a semiconductor microring resonator by optical injection of carriers
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate fast lightwave switching by carriers injection in a laterally coupled GaAs/AlGaAs microring resonator. Switching is due to refractive index change by carrier injection that shifts the microring resonance.

articleTitle: A novel technique for wavelength independent bias of Mach-Zehnder modulators
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A novel wavelength insensitive biasing technique is proposed. The technique significantly reduces the second order distortion and increases the optical bandwidth of Mach-Zehnder modulators.

articleTitle: 1-THz offset frequency measurement using lightwave synthesized frequency sweeper
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We report the offset frequency measurement of two lasers using a broadband lightwave synthesized frequency sweeper and a simple frequency discrimination method. We successfully measured a 1-THz offset frequency with a 1.7-MHz resolution.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a novel technique for optical generation of millimeter-wave signals
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel technique for the optical generation of high-purity millimeter-wave signals up to 330 GHz by synthesizing the outputs from cascaded phase-locked multiple semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Progress in femtosecond technology for ultrafast communication networks
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Summary form only given. An overview of the recent progress of ultrafast all-optical devices being developed for the application to optical time-division multiplexing (OTDM) communication and signal processing systems is given. In parallel with active on-going development of wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) systems, OTDM is another indispensable technique to support the rapidly increasing demand of system throughput. We review recent development of femtosecond all-optical devices such as semiconductor laser light sources, pulse compression devices, and all-optical switches.

articleTitle: High order intermodulation distortion analysis with consideration of nonlinear compensation in direct optical FM RoF system
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper shows the method that designs the optimum receiver for IM3 and IM5 distortion in a radio-on-fiber (RoF) link. The results show that the receiver can be configured by expanding a conventional nonlinear compensation scheme.

articleTitle: Simulation of interference signal in the direct optical switching CDMA scheme with higher order bandpass sampling
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: To improve the signal quality of direct optical switching (DOS)-CDMA signals, a higher-order bandpass sampling scheme has been proposed. The interference signal behavior of this scheme has been discussed theoretically. This paper clarifies the influence of the interference signal and effectiveness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: BER performance under Rician fading environments in radio-on-fiber ubiquitous antenna architecture for road-to-vehicle wireless CDM system
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper evaluates the BER performance under a Rician fading environment in a radio-on-fiber ubiquitous antenna architecture for road-to-vehicle wireless CDM system. As a result, the BER performance is improved in comparison with that of using a single RBS without an SS radio transmission scheme.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic sectorized remote antenna for millimeter-wave broadband wireless access systems
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: In order to realize an equalized service area in millimeter-wave broadband wireless access systems economically, we proposed a fiber-optic sectorized remote antenna by using SCM and CWDM techniques to cover shaded areas of service.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband generation and detection of terahertz waveforms
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present novel photoconductive (PC) switching geometries for the generation of both transmission-line-coupled and free-space terahertz (THz) waveforms. Insight is gained into the operation of these devices through time-resolved electro-optic sampling.

articleTitle: A new method for chromatic dispersion measurement of WDM components by using photonic microwave technique
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We propose a new method for chromatic dispersion measurement of WDM components both in transmission and reflection, employing photonic microwave technology. Its performance is demonstrated experimentally. Better than /spl plusmn/1ps relative group delay resolution is obtained.

articleTitle: Monolithic InGaAs PIN photodetector-GaAs MHEMT amplifier OEIC fabrication and implementation for 28 GHz LMDS applications
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We have fabricated a monolithic Opto-electronic Integrated Circuit (OEIC) comprising of an InGaAs PIN photodetector and a Common Gate Amplifier (CGA) using Metamorphic High Electron Mobility Transistors (MHEMTs) on 4 inch GaAs substrates. The OEIC shows a gain of 28 dB at 28 GHz with an 8 GHz FWHM.

articleTitle: R&D strategies for information sharing services in the broadband age
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper outlines NTT's R&D strategies for making Informative Ambience (an information-rich environment) a reality. Examples are given of broadband and ubiquitous services, based on the bi-directional super-high-speed photonic network and broadband wireless network.

articleTitle: Broadband radio-frequency spectrum analyzer based on spectral hole burning
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate application of spectral hole burning to the spectral analysis of broadband radio frequency signals. The device operates on an optically carried RF signal and achieves the angular separation of the signal spectral components.

articleTitle: Experiment on optical interaction with spin waves in nonuniform bias magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: With the use of a turning point observed in a nonuniform bias magnetic field, the optical interaction with spin waves has been investigated experimentally for a single crystal slab and a thick film of yttrium iron garnet magnetized longitudinally.

articleTitle: Time-bandwidth product of the time stretched analog-to-digital converter
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The time-bandwidth product of the time stretched analog-to-digital converter is modeled in terms of its dependence on physical system parameters. Using the time-bandwidth product as the figure of merit, the performances of baseband double-sideband modulation, passband double-sideband modulation, and single-sideband modulation are compared and quantified.

articleTitle: Microwaves generated by a laser induced, pulsed, picosecond, E-M source (LIPPES)
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Two configurations of photoconductive source/antenna activated by short duration laser pulses are described. The nonlinear characteristics of the radiated fields as well as the dielectric nature of the individual elements suggest that a non-interactive 3-D array can be constructed with the designs described.

articleTitle: Novel photonic filter and receiver based on whispering gallery mode microresonators
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We describe two new devices based on whispering gallery mode microresonators. The first device, a multipole filter, is based on coupled microresonators, the frequency of which is trimmed in situ to produce the desired filter function. The second device is based on a lithium niobate microresonator, which can detect applied microwave signals with power as low as 2.5 nW.

articleTitle: High-performance EAM-integrated SGDBR laser for WDM microwave photonic applications
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A high-performance widely tuneable optical source is presented for microwave photonic applications. An EAM (electroabsorption waveguide modulator)-integrated SGDBR (sampled grating distributed Bragg reflector) laser is characterised with regards to noise and linearity at 1530 nm, 1545 nm and 1560 nm. By selecting the EAM bias point, 99 dBc/Hz/sup 1/2/ broadband spurious-free dynamic range or a 114 dBc/Hz/sup 2/3/ sub-octave spurious-free dynamic range is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical single-sideband modulation by using periodically domain-inverted LiTaO/sub 3/ guided-wave modulators
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Optical single-sideband modulation around 15 GHz was demonstrated by using novel electrooptic LiTaO/sub 3/ guided-wave modulators with the periodically domain-inverted structure. The peak modulation frequency and the modulation bandwidth were in good agreement with theoretical values.

articleTitle: Study of ultra-fast polarization switching in thin film ferroelectric capacitors
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We report the results on polarization switching in fully integrated ferroelectric thin film capacitor using jitter-free, ultra-fast rise-time electrical pulses generated by a semiconductor photoconductive switch with femto-second laser illumination.

articleTitle: Two stage integrated SOA modulators as efficient photonic mixers for microwave signals
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Here, we present an improved device for an SOA based photonic mixer, where two different SOA modulators are placed in tandem, separated by a lossy section. The SOAs are operated under a linear modulation regime. This device shows important advantages in terms of conversion gain over previously reported ones, and can be easily integrated. Furthermore, since it is based on the same technology as multi-electrode semiconductor lasers it is a potential low cost device since it can benefit from the economy of scale of this technology.

articleTitle: 155 Mbit/s data transmission at 40 GHz using a dispersion-tolerant optical coherent generation technique with simultaneous LO remoting
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The transmission of a 155 Mbit/s 40 GHz modulated carrier through a 2.2 km SSMF link is demonstrated using a technique for dispersion-tolerant optical harmonic generation of modulated microwave/millimeter-wave signals with simultaneous LO remoting, which employs a single laser and a single dual-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator.

articleTitle: High-quality organic 4-dimethylamino-n-methyl-4-stilbazolium tosylate (DAST) crystal for electro-optic measurement applications
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present a new method called the slope nucleation method (SNM) for the growth of high-quality DAST crystals. Electro-optic (EO) measurement shows DAST crystals exhibits five-times sensitivity enhancement as compared to KTiOPO/sub 4/ (KTP) crystals.

articleTitle: Synthesis of orthogonal dual-mode optical BPSK signals by a monolithic LiNbO/sub 3/ modulator
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A modulation scheme is proposed for synthesizing a dual-mode optical BPSK signal pair with an orthogonal phase relationship, which affords generation of orthogonal dual-mode optical signals for QPSK or SCM.

articleTitle: Optical pulse self-processing in nonlinear periodic systems
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We review progress in periodically nonlinear devices for optical signal processing. We focus on applications in pulse reshaping including optical limiting. We discuss the design of devices towards a specific application and identify the properties of materials and structures needed to implement these objectives.

articleTitle: Pre-weighting space division multiplexing reception based on RoF ubiquitous antenna system
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper proposes a new type of pre-weighting space division multiplexing scheme for down-link in a radio-on-fiber ubiquitous antenna system. The proposed system can achieve a signal-to-interference ratio of about 25 dB under four co-channel signals without any interference cancellation at the mobile terminals.

articleTitle: All-optical frequency up-conversion using a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present a new scheme of up-converting optical IF signals with an optical LO signal by using an SOA. It is able to provide high conversion efficiency and is independent of the incident light wavelengths and polarizations.

articleTitle: Undesired mode suppression of optical millimeter wave signal generated by injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser diode
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We investigate the undesired locked-mode (UDLM) suppression in the sub-harmonically injection locking of the Fabry-Perot laser in generating a two-mode optical millimeter-wave signal. We find that more than 13 dB improvement of the UDLM suppression can be achieved by optimizing the injection power and the modulation index of the master laser.

articleTitle: Analysis of chromatic dispersion induced second harmonic distortions including semiconductor laser dynamics [optical links]
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: Investigating the phase relationship of distortion caused by laser diode dynamics, we accurately modeled chromatic dispersion induced second harmonic distortion. We confirmed that the results agree well with experiments in wide ranges of frequency and dispersion.

articleTitle: A new electro-optical phase shifter for optically generated microwave signals
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: The direct modulation of DFB laser diodes leads to higher harmonics of the modulation frequency. We investigated the phase of the harmonics depending on the DC current and on the amplitude of the modulation signal.

articleTitle: Measurement of the electric field distribution on a resonant electrode in high-speed optical modulator using electro-optic sampling
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: By using electro-optic sampling technique, the electric field distribution on a resonant electrode for optical modulation was measured with resolution of a few micrometers. We showed that the measured electric field distribution at the edge of the electrode was different from the results obtained by an equivalent circuit model.

articleTitle: Investigation of strain effects on performance of high-speed Schottky-type photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: PIN and Schottky photodetectors (PDs) having an InGaAs absorption layer are widely used for long distance optical communication. The speed of those PDs is generally limited by hole transition time in the absorption layer. This limit can be overcome by using a tensile-strain In/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As (x<0.53) absorption layer. We fabricated and characterized Schottky-type PDs having a lattice-matched In/sub 0.53/Ga/sub 0.47/As absorption layer and a tensile-strained In/sub 0.48/Ga/sub 0.52/As absorption layer. Photocurrent impulse response of the tensile-strained InAlAs/In/sub 0.48/Ga/sub 0.52/As PD showed an improved FWHM of 13 ps, while that of the the lattice-matched InAlAs/In/sub 0.53/Ga/sub 0.47/As PD was 16 ps.

articleTitle: Application of a single-mode fiber to a sub-THz spectrometer using incoherent light
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: A continuous-wave incoherent light source and photoconductive antennas constitute a low-cost spectrometer in the sub-THz region. Filtering the light by a single-mode fiber brings a change in signal waveforms, favorable to the spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Small signal equivalent circuit of illuminated HPTs
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: This paper describes the behavior of equivalent-circuit parameters of illuminated Heterojunction Photo Transistors (HPTs). The equivalent circuit is based on the Gummel-Poon model. It is clarified that S-parameters and each parameter change in value when the HPT is illuminated. Further, the measured characteristics of illuminated HPTs are compared with the calculated from the proposed model of illuminated HPTs.

articleTitle: 20 Gsample/s optoelectronic wavelength-division sampling for application to radar signals
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present a simulation of an optoelectronic sampling method based a wavelength division and realizing signal processing at a sampling rate of 20 Gsample/s. We proposed then the application of this technique to the processing of chirped radar signals.

articleTitle: Temperature insensitive and low cost transversal filters based on uniform fibre Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2002 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics
abstract: We present temperature insensitive and low cost transversal filters based on uniform fibre Bragg gratings used as slicing elements of a broadband optical source. The performance of these filters is compared to the laser array approach.
